section_role: UV unwrapping evaluation, ablation, and texture generation intro

method_evidence.claim: SeamGPT uses autoregressive transformer with point cloud sampling along edges and vertices for seam generation
method_evidence.anchor: sampling point clouds along edges and vertices produces seams that naturally conform to the mesh topologies... sampling along edges and vertices significantly improves model convergence, as the transformer gains explicit positional awareness of potential cutting coordinates

method_evidence.claim: Point-cloud encoder outperforms mesh encoder for seam generation
method_evidence.anchor: point-cloud encoder yields superior results compared to mesh encoders

method_evidence.claim: Pointer Network fails to generate consistent seams
method_evidence.anchor: Pointer network struggles to generate consistent seams, often resulting in discontinuous cuts

method_evidence.claim: Seam length ratio R defined as seam segment count / number of mesh vertices, valid range [0.1, 0.35]
method_evidence.anchor: We define R as the ratio of seam segment count to the number of mesh vertices. Empirically, valid cutting seams typically has R value within the range [0.1,0.35]

experiment_evidence.claim: SeamGPT outperforms XAtlas, Nuvo, FAM, Edge-CLS in user study on Boundary quality and Editability
